name: Material Ui Nextjs
summary: Integrates Material UI with Next.js App and Pages routers using @mui/material-nextjs, Emotion cache providers, next/font, CSS layers with Tailwind/CSS Modules, Link component prop patterns, CSS theme variables SSR notes, and App Router useSearchParams + Suspense. Use when setting up or debugging MUI in a Next.js app.

name: Material Ui Styling
summary: Chooses the right Material UI styling approach (sx, styled, theme overrides, global CSS) from official MUI guidance. Use when styling @mui/material components, customizing themes, overriding slots, or comparing sx vs styled.

name: Material Ui Theming
summary: Guides Material UI theming and design tokens (createTheme, ThemeProvider, palette, colorSchemes, cssVariables, theme.vars, dark mode, TypeScript augmentation). Use when building or extending a theme, toggling light/dark, or aligning tokens across an app.
